---
description: Gaia Steward build agent on the copilot engine (generated by scripts/gen_steward_agent_workflows.py)
on:
  workflow_dispatch:
    inputs:
      dispatch-id:
        description: "Steward dispatch id (for the receipt)"
        required: true
        type: string
      base:
        description: "Integration branch the change is based on"
        required: true
        type: string
      branch:
        description: "Branch the change is pushed to (steward/b/...)"
        required: true
        type: string
      prompt:
        description: "The steward builder prompt, verbatim"
        required: true
        type: string
permissions:
  contents: read
  actions: read
  copilot-requests: write
concurrency:
  job-discriminator: ${{ github.event.inputs.dispatch-id }}
timeout-minutes: 45
engine: copilot
imports:
  - shared/steward-build.md
---

Run the Gaia Steward build task defined in the imported shared workflow.
